ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: There are two scatter plots arranged vertically in the figure. The title of the upper scatter plot shows r = -0.8078, and the points are distributed roughly along an obvious negative-slope direction, with a relatively steep downward fitted line. The title of the lower scatter plot shows r = -0.4245, and the main point group is similar to the upper figure, but on the right side there are extreme points far away from the main point group/linear trend, making the downward trend obviously weaker. Therefore, in this example, the r value is sensitive to outliers.
